value.name: Alice watches documentary and cries
value.description: Alice watches a crack documentary with her family and breaks down over Dicky's situation.
evidence: ALICE'S & GEORGE WARD'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT. Alice cries as she watches "High On Crack Street" with George and a couple of her daughters.
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house - living room

value.name: Alice shields Dicky from documentary
value.description: Alice tells Little Dicky not to watch the documentary and sends him upstairs.
evidence: Little Dicky comes in. ALICE (wiping away her tears, dialing phone) No, sweetie, go back upstairs, you can't watch this.
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house - living room

value.name: Alice calls Micky about Dicky
value.description: Alice phones Micky to complain about what is happening to Dicky and their family.
evidence: [into phone] Micky, can you believe what they're doin' to us?
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house - living room

value.name: Micky defends Dicky's responsibility
value.description: Micky, upset on the phone, says Dicky brought the trouble on himself.
evidence: MICKY (into phone) Ma, I know, but he did it to himself.
value.location_hint: Micky's apartment above garage - living room/kitchen

value.name: Alice insists Dicky was set up
value.description: Alice argues that Dicky was framed and that the drugs and film were planted on him.
evidence: ALICE (on phone) What was he thinkin!? They set him up!
ALICE (on phone) Maybe they got the drugs for 'im an' the movie—
value.location_hint: Alice's & George Ward's house - living room

value.name: Charlene surprises Micky at the door
value.description: While Micky is on the phone, Charlene arrives unexpectedly and he is visibly shocked to see her again.
evidence: KNOCKING ON THE DOOR, HE OPENS IT AS HE LISTENS TO PHONE—CHARLENE IS THERE.
Micky's eyes widen with surprise. He hasn't seen her in a while.
value.location_hint: Micky's apartment above garage - living room/kitchen

value.name: Micky ends call to be with Charlene
value.description: Micky cuts off his mother and turns his attention to Charlene, saying he will call back later.
evidence: MICKY (staring at Charlene) It's very sad, ma, I gotta call ya back. He hangs up.
value.location_hint: Micky's apartment above garage - living room/kitchen

value.name: Micky and Charlene reconnect emotionally
value.description: Micky and Charlene share an awkward, emotional reunion and embrace through tears.
evidence: He and Charlene stare at each other, taking it in, emotional, awkward.
She laughs a little through tears. They hug.
Micky crying into her shoulder and hair, Charlene holding onto him
value.location_hint: Micky's apartment above garage - living room/kitchen

value.name: Micky and Charlene sleep together
value.description: Charlene backs Micky into his bedroom and they end up kissing on the bed.
evidence: she backs him into his bedroom, they fall to the bed, kissing.

value.name: Micky packs boxing gear
value.description: Early the next morning, Micky gathers his boxing wraps and gloves into a gym bag, preparing to leave.
evidence: MICKY'S BEDROOM - EARLY NEXT MORNING. Next morning. Micky's hands grab dingy white boxing wraps out of the darkness of his messy closet, faded red gloves, throws them into an old blue gym bag, leaves.

value.name: Charlene wakes after night together
value.description: Charlene sits up groggy in Micky's shirt and gets out of bed after spending the night with him.
evidence: Charlene sits up in bed, groggy, gets up in Micky's t-shirt, goes out.

value.name: Micky leaves with gym bag
value.description: Micky stands at the top of the stairs with his gym bag, heading out after the night with Charlene.
